related_declarations.provides: Minimum of a nonempty finite set in its original ordered type; a proof of nonemptiness is required.

related_declarations.name: Finset.sum_div
related_declarations.type: ∀ {ι : Type u} {K : Type v} [DivisionSemiring K] (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → K) (a : K), (∑ i ∈ s, f i) / a = ∑ i ∈ s, f i / a
related_declarations.provides: Normalization of a finite sum by a common denominator; totalized field division does not provide a statistical zero-denominator convention.

related_declarations.name: Real.sqrt
related_declarations.type: ℝ → ℝ
related_declarations.provides: Nonnegative square root of a real number, returning zero on negative inputs; intended statistical denominators still require their domain and nonzero conditions.

searches.mechanism: Archive-pinned local rg search and direct declaration/body inspection
searches.query: Searched CUSUM statistics and inspected finite minima, centered-prefix sums and square-root normalization against the lower-tail test statistic.
searches.result: The minimum of standardized centered partial sums is directly expressible for a nonempty index set and a valid estimated standard deviation. The primitives do not prove its limiting law or define exceptional zero/negative variance-estimate cases.

library_audit.gap: The centered-prefix minimum needs a valid positive estimated standard deviation, with finite-sample exceptional cases and the test calibration handled separately.
